# 2 Clement — Chapter 2 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 2
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. "Rejoice, O barren one who does not bear; break forth and cry aloud, you who are not in labor; because the children of the desolate woman are more than those of her who has a husband." — In saying "Rejoice, O barren one who does not bear," he is speaking of us; for our church was barren before children were given to it.
2. And in saying "Cry aloud, you who are not in labor," this means: let us offer up our prayers to God in sincerity, not growing faint like those who are in travail.
3. "Because the children of the desolate woman are more than those of her who has a husband" — because our people seemed to have been abandoned by God, but now, having believed, we have become more numerous than those who seemed to have God.
4. And another scripture says: "I came not to call the righteous, but sinners." — This means that those who are perishing must be saved.
5. For it is great and admirable to give strength not to those who are standing, but to those who are falling.
6. So also Christ was pleased to save what was perishing, and he saved many, coming and calling us who were already perishing.
